Interface MyBatisMapperScanRegistration

public interface MyBatisMapperScanRegistration
Registers mapper interfaces with the MyBatis Configuration of a datasource.

Implementations are generated by the micronaut-mybatis-processor for every MyBatisMapperScan and discovered through META-INF/services. They are applied by MyBatisFactory after all MyBatisConfigurationCustomizer beans.

Since:
7.3.0

    • addMappers

      default void addMappers(org.apache.ibatis.session.Configuration configuration, String packageName)
      Adds all mapper interfaces of a package using MyBatis runtime scanning. This is the JVM fallback for packages in which the annotation processor could not discover any mapper interface. Unlike Configuration.addMappers(String), interfaces already known to the configuration (for example because they are also listed explicitly) are skipped.
      Parameters:
      configuration - The MyBatis configuration
      packageName - The package name
